key: TAKA: Stone Edge, huh...
en: TAKA: Stone Edge, huh...
ja: タカ: ストーンエッジ　ですか……

key: I wonder if this was his TM.
en: I wonder if this was his TM.
ja: これが　父の　わざマシンだったのかも　しれません。

key: If he left it here...
en: If he left it here...
ja: ここに　残していったなら……

key: He probably intended me to use it someday.
en: He probably intended me to use it someday.
ja: きっと　いつか　僕に　使ってほしかった　んでしょうね。

key: You should take it.
en: You should take it.
ja: あなたが　持っていてください。

key: I'm not going to live up to his corrupted legacy anyway.
en: I'm not going to live up to his corrupted legacy anyway.
ja: どのみち　あの人の　腐った遺産に　僕は　ふさわしくないので。

key: TAKA: After that last room, I could go for another five of those.
en: TAKA: After that last room, I could go for another five of those.
ja: タカ: さっきの部屋の後だと　あんなのが　あと5体　来ても　いけそうです。

key: There's a button below the statue of Arceus.
en: There's a button below the statue of Arceus.
ja: アルセウスの像の下に　ボタンが　ある。

key: Press it?
en: Press it?
ja: 押しますか?

key: TAKA: Another one...
en: TAKA: Another one...
ja: タカ: また　一つ……

key: Yeah, seems like there's a button here too.
en: Yeah, seems like there's a button here too.
ja: ええ　ここにも　ボタンが　あるみたいです。

key: Go ahead.
en: Go ahead.
ja: どうぞ。

key: TAKA: Not gonna lie, I was high-key worried I just condemned us both to death by having you press this place's self-destruct button.
en: TAKA: Not gonna lie, I was high-key worried I just condemned us both to death by having you press this place's self-destruct button.
ja: タカ: 正直に言うと　この場所の自爆ボタンを　あなたに　押させて　二人とも　死なせちゃったんじゃないかって　結構　本気で　心配してました。

key: Let's see...
en: Let's see...
ja: ええと……

key: Oh, it looks like there are some sand pits in the ground where there weren't before.
en: Oh, it looks like there are some sand pits in the ground where there weren't before.
ja: あ　前は　なかった砂の穴が　地面に　できてるみたいです。

key: TAKA: Not yet?
en: TAKA: Not yet?
ja: タカ: まだ?

key: The button is shoved firmly into the statue already.
en: The button is shoved firmly into the statue already.
ja: ボタンは　すでに　像に　しっかり　押しこまれている。

key: TAKA: This one won't do any more...
en: TAKA: This one won't do any more...
ja: タカ: これ以上は　もう　無理みたいですね……

key: But isn't it a little odd for a shrine to have a mechanism like that?
en: But isn't it a little odd for a shrine to have a mechanism like that?
ja: でも　神社に　こんな仕掛けが　あるのって　少し　変じゃ　ないですか?

key: I guess it's a shrine, anyway.
en: I guess it's a shrine, anyway.
ja: まあ　神社　ではあるんでしょうけど。

key: At the least, I'm pretty sure my father prayed here when we came before...
en: At the least, I'm pretty sure my father prayed here when we came before...
ja: 少なくとも　前に来たとき　父は　ここで　祈っていた気が　します……

key: TAKA: I think this says something about a "guardian legacy"?
en: TAKA: I think this says something about a "guardian legacy"?
ja: タカ: これ「守護者の遺産」がどうとか　書いてある気が　します?

key: It's way too faded to read.
en: It's way too faded to read.
ja: 色あせすぎて　読めません。

key: TAKA: I remember seeing this before... How long ago was it?
en: TAKA: I remember seeing this before... How long ago was it?
ja: タカ: これ　前にも　見た気が　します……　どれくらい　前だったかな?

key: TAKA: All right, heart attack over?
en: TAKA: All right, heart attack over?
ja: タカ: よし　心臓発作は　終わりですか?

key: Yeah?
en: Yeah?
ja: ですよね?

key: Years shaved off of life?
en: Years shaved off of life?
ja: 寿命は　何年　削れました?

key: Yeah.
en: Yeah.
ja: ですね。

key: I don't think they'll follow us out here.
en: I don't think they'll follow us out here.
ja: ここまでは　追ってこないと　思います。

key: I can't believe I forgot about that...
en: I can't believe I forgot about that...
ja: あれを　忘れてたなんて　信じられません……

key: He told me at the time it was some kind of trial left for us by our family...
en: He told me at the time it was some kind of trial left for us by our family...
ja: あのとき　父は　これが　僕らの一族が　残した　何かの試練だと　言ってました……

key: I can't help but think that was absolutely not necessary.
en: I can't help but think that was absolutely not necessary.
ja: 絶対に　必要なかったと　思わずには　いられません。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
